name: Dr Hamish Dow
bio: Group leader and self-proclaimed mad inventor. Hamish is interested in anything that involves infrastructure and/or data.

name: Lawrence King
bio: Lawrence is researching methods for automated inspection of safety-critical infrastructure pipework.

name: Matthew Smith
bio: Matthew's research looks at optimisation of friction-fit modular timber construction.

name: Callum Dalrymple
bio: Callum's is researching asset management of half-joint bridges.

name: Henry Seekamp
bio: Henry was a visiting researcher from the University of Washington. At his time at Strathclyde in 2026 he looked at image-based assessment of confined spaces on concrete structures.

name: Kiyali Alex Soro
bio: Alex was a visiting researcher from Le Centre des études supérieures industrielles (CESI). While at Strathclyde in 2026 he conducted research on finite element analysis of reinforced concrete half-joints.
